claims.statement: Eight defects introduced by PR #39 and found by a review that completed after it merged are corrected. VERIFIED by checking each against the repository before changing anything: no receipt_id in .quirk/evidence begins with 'qreceipt.living-documents', so the roadmap's cited locator resolved to nothing, and the five real identifiers begin 'qreceipt.living-document-'; .devcontainer exists at the repository root and CODEOWNERS omitted it while claiming to map every root surface; the review dates 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05 are one and two days after 2026-10-03, not one and three; the second title-lint success is run 35602325469 on head b197032d06997f1045a6d9e30d100ae84f11e984, not the unresolvable '35601'; OWNER_ACTIVATION_INPUTS.md asserted in its opening that repository content cannot change egress block mode and asserted the opposite later in the same file; validate_living_docs.py reports a document stale only after its Review by date, so the todo had not lapsed when re-read one day early and the 'Lapse record' heading and its first sentence were both false. VERIFIED at this commit: 180 tests pass under Python 3.12, scripts/validate.sh reports all executed checks passed, and validate_living_docs.py --strict reports 4 documents and 0 stale. CORRECTION OF AN EARLIER RECEIPT: qreceipt.living-doc-relapse.4abe5a8d177f describes the same non-event as a lapse in a verified claim. Its bytes are deliberately unchanged, because a receipt records what was believed at its subject commit and editing one to read correctly afterwards would destroy the property that makes receipts worth having; this receipt is the correction of record. UNKNOWN: whether any further finding from that review remains unaddressed, since the review completed after the pull request was closed and no check re-ran against the merged result.
